definitions: To become insane or mentally unstable.
To become extremely angry, frustrated, or excited.
To act in a very irrational or foolish way.
examples: He might lose his mind if he doesn't get some rest.
She's going to lose her mind with all this stress.
Don't lose your mind over such a small mistake.
pastTenses: lost one's mind (simple past), has/have lost one's mind (present perfect)
